Hi all — quick update from the solutions side. We ran a baseline on our staging pool with a similar model and config; summary below and attachments included.

Baseline notes:
- Instance profile: 4x A10G equivalent (shared large-instance pool)
- Sustained concurrency tested: 600 concurrent streams using our continuous-batching harness
- Observed p95 latency: ~220ms with caching enabled and batching window tuned to 30ms
- Token throughput: ~1,100 tokens/sec aggregate across streams during test bursts

Recommendation:
- The shared large-instance pool should meet your 600 concurrency / p95 < 250ms target for initial stress-runs. If you want tighter headroom or longer sustained runs, request a short dedicated capacity window.

Attached: load_test_plan_v1.md, test-harness-config.json (stub), quick-run checklist. Steps to get ready:
1) Provide an allowlisted staging IP for our test runner (or share access to your staging VPC).
2) Confirm dataset slices and any prompt templates to pin during the test.
3) If you want us to run longer runs (>2h) indicate that so we can schedule dedicated capacity.
